messages:
frank (finance): We're rolling out a new "Tiered Burst Buffer" (TBB) approach and an updated invoice summary view to reduce surprise overage alerts for customers with spiky traffic. Target GA: 2025-12-15. Pilot signups start 2025-11-30.

maya (product): TL;DR for customers?

frank (finance): TBB gives each route a small burst allowance that can borrow from unused bursts in the same account group. It smooths short spikes so customers see fewer one-off overages. Also, we'll show burst_tokens and burst_adjustment on invoice lines.

leo (eng-platform): Engineering notes: enforcement lives in the request-router. New billing export fields: "burst_tokens", "burst_adjustment" (none|redistributed|waived), and "pool_label". We'll add a console metric "burst_pool_util". Canary Nov 25, region rollouts early Dec.

nina (support): Need canned replies, a short FAQ, and sample invoices. Also a support flow for Dedicated customers who want to lock burst to a fixed amount.

compliance-bot: Legal check: add a short addendum clarifying this is a billing presentation feature, not a price change. Offer 30-day grace for enterprise SLA customers.

maya (product): Marketing will prepare a help center article and an in-console banner. Please provide a 1-pager by Nov 20.

frank (finance): Notes on credits: trial credits will be redeemable over 90 days instead of month-by-month. Existing trial customers are grandfathered for 45 days. We'll track cost impact during the pilot and share results at billing syncs.

leo (eng-platform): Export schema and webhook payloads will be published in the billing API docs. Dedicated/private: toggles available; private deployments will get a config flag and migration script.

nina (support): I'll compile top-15 FAQs and example invoice CSVs for CS by Nov 22.

frank (finance): Announcement email scheduled 2025-11-30 17:00 UTC. Console teaser on 2025-12-01. DM me for pilot list requests. :bell:
